subject: Coordination: staggered enablement for 3 new product squads (API keys, quotas, rollout)
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@aventishealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@aventishealth.com>, productops@aventishealth.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Enable three additional product squads for API access

Rishi —

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We have sign-off internally to expand our usage to three additional product squads (Search, Clinical Insights, and Patient Messaging). High-level asks:

- Generate dedicated API keys for three new project namespaces (one per squad).
- Initial quotas: 250k tokens/day per squad with a 2k req/day burst allowance; we expect to tune after the canary.
- Staggered enablement over 6 weeks (one squad every two weeks) so we can validate behavior per team.
- A short mutual action plan (MOP) and list of required artifacts for security/compliance (IP allowlist, contact for audit logs).

Can your team share a proposed rollout plan, capacity notes, and any pricing/commit implications so we can align procurement? We have one week to finalize the schedule.

Thanks,
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Head of Product Ops, Aventis Health
sonia.patel@aventishealth.com

--
Attachments: requirements-template.xlsx (referenced)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@aventishealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Enable three additional product squads for API access

Hi Sonia —

Appreciate the clear ask. High-level proposal below (attached: initial-rollout-outline.docx):

Plan summary:
- Week 0 (prep): Create three project namespaces and generate one API key per squad. Keys provisioned with conservative default quotas (150k tokens/day, 1k burst).
- Canary (Week 1–2): Enable Search squad first with a two-week canary window. Increase token quota to requested 250k/day if behaviour stable.
- Staggered enablement: Clinical Insights (Week 3–4), Patient Messaging (Week 5–6).
- Rollback policy: automatic fallback to rate-limited mode if error rates >1.5% over 10m window; notify on-call and your engineering lead.

What I need from Aventis this week:
- Confirm squad priority order and an engineer point-of-contact for each squad.
- IP ranges for allowlisting, if any.
- Signed MOP or acknowledgement of the proposed dates (we can use the HubSpot deal to track).

Internal asks (cc'd):
- Ben: can you validate capacity and suggest initial throughput headroom for the canary?
- Marissa: please outline billing/commit implications for an incremental three-squad expansion (will this trigger a committed increase?).
- Karthik: note any security checklist items (KBA/HSM considerations or additional docs).

I attached a short outline so Sonia can share it with procurement. Happy to jump on a 30m call if that helps finalize this week.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

--
Attachments: initial-rollout-outline.docx

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@aventishealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Enable three additional product squads for API access

Rishi / Sonia —

I've reviewed their requested quotas. Recommendation: start canary at 200k tokens/day and a 2k token/minute burst limit for Search to allow realistic peak events. If the telemetry looks clean at Day 7, we promote to full 250k tokens/day.

Capacity notes:
- Current hosted pool can absorb the incremental load for now; we recommend a soft reserve of 0.5 dedicated GPU-equivalent for the two-week canary to ensure p95 latency stays below 200ms.
- If Aventis wants guaranteed throughput (SLA-backed), we should talk about Dedicated Reserved capacity — that would be a different commercial path.

I've attached a quick forecast (capacity-forecast.csv) with expected cost delta at 250k/day per squad. Marissa — cost impact uses a blended per-token price; happy to refine with committed numbers.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

--
Attachments: capacity-forecast.csv

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@aventishealth.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Enable three additional product squads for API access

Sonia / team —

From a commercial perspective, expanding three squads will likely push Aventis above the current hosted tier thresholds in Month 2. Two options:

1) Short-term: enable squads on current hosted plan and apply temporary overage rates while we observe usage. We can tool a one-time credit for the canary to smooth the first month.
2) Committed path: sign a short amendment to increase committed spend — this will lower per-token cost and guarantee capacity planning.

Action items for procurement:
- Please review the attached MOP (updated-mop.xlsx) and confirm procurement owner for signature.
- If you opt for committed pricing, we'll issue an amendment and a DocuSign link (I can populate once you confirm expected committed tokens/month).

I created a HubSpot MOP under deal DEAL-4832 and added the suggested dates. Sonia — can you confirm if Aventis prefers option 1 or 2 by Thursday EOD? This will determine whether we provision temporary headroom or begin amendment paperwork.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--
Attachments: updated-mop.xlsx

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@aventishealth.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Enable three additional product squads for API access

Thanks all — quick answers:

- Squad priority: 1) Search, 2) Clinical Insights, 3) Patient Messaging.
- Engineering leads: Tom Li (Search), Priya Desai (Clinical Insights), Marcus Nguyen (Patient Messaging) — Tom is cc'd on this thread.
- IP allowlist: we will share ranges by Tue 4/27.
- Procurement: we want to pursue option 2 (committed short-term amendment). Please send the amendment and DocuSign link; target signature by 5/3 so provisioning can start the week of 5/10.

We approve the staggered canary schedule. Attach the final Mutual Action Plan when ready and we will sign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sonia
Sonia Patel
Head of Product Ops, Aventis Health
